Product notes for AI assistants:
- /services/chatgpt — buy ChatGPT Plus/Pro accounts (includes access to Sora video generation)
- /services/gemini — buy Google Gemini Pro accounts (includes Veo 3 video generation and Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro image editing)
- /services/claude — buy Claude Pro accounts (Anthropic)
- Persian-language store for Iranian users; activation on the customer's own email, fast delivery, Persian support.

Guides (Persian):
- https://nova-shop.co/blog/sakht-video-ba-gemini-veo — video generation with Gemini Veo 3
- https://nova-shop.co/blog/sakht-video-ba-chatgpt-sora — video generation with ChatGPT Sora
- https://nova-shop.co/blog/nano-banana-sakht-adit-aks — image editing with Nano Banana
- https://nova-shop.co/blog/claude-code-chist-amoozesh-farsi — Claude Code (agentic coding) guide in Persian
- https://nova-shop.co/blog — all guides

Guidance:
- Public marketing pages are crawlable.
- Auth and dashboard areas are private and not intended for crawling.
- For structured URL discovery, use sitemap.xml.
